G3800.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of the same as G3795 (ὀψάριον);
G3800.def: rations for a soldier, i.e. (by extension) his stipend or pay

G3801.lemma: ὁ ὢν καί ὁ ἦν καί ὁ ἐρχόμενος
G3801.xlit: ho ṑn kaí ho ēn kaí ho erchómenos
G3801.derivation: a phrase combining G3588 (ὁ) with the present participle and imperfect of G1510 (εἰμί) and the present participle of G2064 (ἔρχομαι) by means of G2532 (καί);
G3801.def: the one being and the one that was and the one coming, i.e. the Eternal, as a divine epithet of Christ
G3801.kjv: which art (is, was), and (which) wast (is, was), and art (is) to come (shalt be)

G3803.def: a trap (as fastened by a noose or notch); figuratively, a trick or statagem (temptation)

G3804.derivation: from a presumed derivative of G3806 (πάθος);
G3804.def: something undergone, i.e. hardship or pain; subjectively, an emotion or influence

G3806.def: properly, suffering ("pathos"), i.e. (subjectively) a passion (especially concupiscence)

G3807.derivation: from G3816 (παῖς) and a reduplicated form of G71 (ἄγω);
G3807.def: a boy-leader, i.e. a servant whose office it was to take the children to school; (by implication, (figuratively) a tutor ("pædagogue"))

G3808.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G3816 (παῖς);

G3809.def: tutorage, i.e. education or training; by implication, disciplinary correction

G3810.def: a trainer, i.e. teacher or (by implication) discipliner

G3811.def: to train up a child, i.e. educate, or (by implication), discipline (by punishment)

G3813.def: a childling (of either sex), i.e. (properly), an infant, or (by extension) a half-grown boy or girl; figuratively, an immature Christian

G3814.def: a girl, i.e. (specially), a female slave or servant

G3816.def: a boy (as often beaten with impunity), or (by analogy), a girl, and (genitive case) a child; specially, a slave or servant (especially a minister to a king; and by eminence to God)
G3816.kjv: child, maid(-en), (man) servant, son, young man

G3817.def: to hit (as if by a single blow and less violently than G5180 (τύπτω)); specially, to sting (as a scorpion)

G3818.derivation: feminine of an adjective of uncertain derivation;

G3819.derivation: probably another form for G3825 (πάλιν) (through the idea of retrocession);
G3819.def: (adverbially) formerly, or (by relatively) sometime since; (elliptically as adjective) ancient
G3819.kjv: any while, a great while ago, (of) old, in time past

G3820.def: antique, i.e. not recent, worn out

G3822.def: to make (passively, become) worn out, or declare obsolete

G3824.def: (spiritual) rebirth (the state or the act), i.e. (figuratively) spiritual renovation; specially, Messianic restoration

G3825.derivation: probably from the same as G3823 (πάλη) (through the idea of oscillatory repetition);
G3825.def: (adverbially) anew, i.e. (of place) back, (of time) once more, or (conjunctionally) furthermore or on the other hand

G3826.derivation: dative case (adverb) of a compound of G3956 (πᾶς) and G4128 (πλῆθος);
G3826.def: in full multitude, i.e. concertedly or simultaneously

G3828.derivation: from a compound of G3956 (πᾶς) and G4443 (πυρά);
G3828.def: every-tribal, i.e. heterogeneous (G5561 (χώρα) being implied); Pamphylia, a region of Asia Minor

G3829.derivation: neuter of a presumed compound of G3956 (πᾶς) and a derivative of G1209 (δέχομαι);
G3829.def: all-receptive, i.e. a public lodging-place (caravanserai or khan)

G3831.derivation: from G3956 (πᾶς) and a derivative of G58 (ἀγορά);

G3833.derivation: from a compound of G3956 (πᾶς) and G3696 (ὅπλον);

G3834.def: adroitness, i.e. (in a bad sense) trickery or sophistry

G3837.derivation: genitive case (as adverb of place) of a presumed derivative of G3956 (πᾶς);

G3838.def: full-ended, i.e. entire (neuter as noun, completion)

G3841.def: the all-ruling, i.e. God (as absolute and universal sovereign)

G3842.def: every when, i.e. at all times

G3843.def: entirely; specially, at all events, (with negative, following) in no event
G3843.kjv: by all means, altogether, at all, needs, no doubt, in (no) wise, surely

G3844.def: properly, near; i.e. (with genitive case) from beside (literally or figuratively), (with dative case) at (or in) the vicinity of (objectively or subjectively), (with accusative case) to the proximity with (local (especially beyond or opposed to) or causal (on account of)
G3844.kjv: above, against, among, at, before, by, contrary to, X friend, from, + give (such things as they), + that (she) had, X his, in, more than, nigh unto, (out) of, past, save, side…by, in the sight of, than, (there-)fore, with

G3845.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and the base of G939 (βάσις);
G3845.def: to go contrary to, i.e. violate a command

G3846.def: to throw alongside, i.e. (reflexively) to reach a place, or (figuratively) to liken

G3849.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and the middle voice of G971 (βιάζω);
G3849.def: to force contrary to (nature), i.e. compel (by entreaty)

G3850.def: a similitude ("parable"), i.e. (symbolic) fictitious narrative (of common life conveying a moral), apothegm or adage

G3851.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and the middle voice of G1011 (βουλεύω);

G3853.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and the base of G32 (ἄγγελος);
G3853.def: to transmit a message, i.e. (by implication) to enjoin

G3854.def: to become near, i.e. approach (have arrived); by implication, to appear publicly

G3855.def: to lead near, i.e. (reflexively or intransitively) to go along or away

G3856.def: to show alongside (the public), i.e. expose to infamy
G3856.kjv: make a public example, put to an open shame

G3857.def: a park, i.e. (specially), an Eden (place of future happiness, "paradise")

G3858.def: to accept near, i.e. admit or (by implication) delight in

G3859.derivation: from a compound of G3844 (παρά) and G1304 (διατρίβω);

G3860.def: to surrender, i.e yield up, intrust, transmit
G3860.kjv: betray, bring forth, cast, commit, deliver (up), give (over, up), hazard, put in prison, recommend

G3861.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and G1391 (δόξα) (in the sense of seeming);

G3862.def: transmission, i.e. (concretely) a precept; specially, the Jewish traditionary law

G3863.def: to stimulate alongside, i.e. excite to rivalry

G3867.def: to mispraise, i.e. recommend or advise (a different course)

G3868.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and the middle voice of G154 (αἰτέω);
G3868.def: to beg off, i.e. deprecate, decline, shun

G3870.def: to call near, i.e. invite, invoke (by imploration, hortation or consolation)
G3870.kjv: beseech, call for, (be of good) comfort, desire, (give) exhort(-ation), intreat, pray

G3872.derivation: from a compound of G3844 (παρά) and G2698 (κατατίθημι);
G3872.def: something put down alongside, i.e. a deposit (sacred trust)

G3873.def: to lie near, i.e. be at hand (figuratively, be prompt or easy)

G3877.def: to follow near, i.e. (figuratively) attend (as a result), trace out, conform to
G3877.kjv: attain, follow, fully know, have understanding

G3878.def: to mishear, i.e. (by implication) to disobey

G3879.def: to bend beside, i.e. lean over (so as to peer within)

G3880.def: to receive near, i.e. associate with oneself (in any familiar or intimate act or relation); by analogy, to assume an office; figuratively, to learn

G3881.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and the middle voice of G3004 (λέγω) (in its original sense);
G3881.def: (specially), to lay one's course near, i.e. sail past

G3883.derivation: from a compound of G3844 (παρά) and G236 (ἀλλάσσω);
G3883.def: transmutation (of phase or orbit), i.e. (figuratively) fickleness

G3886.def: to loosen beside, i.e. relax (perfect passive participle, paralyzed or enfeebled)
G3886.kjv: feeble, sick of the (taken with) palsy

G3887.def: to stay near, i.e. remain (literally, tarry; or figuratively, be permanent, persevere)

G3888.derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and the middle voice of a derivative of G3454 (μῦθος);
G3888.def: to relate near, i.e. (by implication) encourage, console

G3891.derivation: from a compound of G3844 (παρά) and G3551 (νόμος);
G3891.def: to be opposed to law, i.e. to transgress

G3893.def: to embitter alongside, i.e. (figuratively) to exasperate

G3895.def: to fall aside, i.e. (figuratively) to apostatize

G3897.derivation: neuter of a compound of G3844 (παρά) and the base of G4139 (πλησίον) (as adverb);

G3898.derivation: adverb from the same as G3897 (παραπλήσιον);
G3898.def: in a manner near by, i.e. (figuratively) similarly
